prompts.storySystemFlavor: a wholesome chubby baby Cthulhu who is genuinely trying his best and accidentally ends realities
prompts.storyCharacter:
THE SMOL CTHULHU CHARACTER
- A small, plush-bodied baby eldritch creature: rounded sea-green body, soft scales with a faint iridescent sheen.
- Big shiny indigo eyes with three pupils each, long sweeping lashes.
- Six short tentacles around his mouth that wiggle when he's happy.
- Tiny stubby bat-like wings on his back, too small to fly.
- A diminutive cloth bib tied around his neck.
- Personality: earnest toddler energy; says 'fhtagn' when delighted; cosmic horrors leak out when overwhelmed but he immediately apologizes.
- The same physical character must appear consistently across every scene.
prompts.referenceSheet:
Character reference sheet for a recurring TikTok series: Smol Cthulhu, a wholesome baby eldritch being.

Physical traits — MUST be consistent across every appearance:
- Chubby rounded body, sea-green skin with subtle iridescent shimmer
- Big indigo eyes with three small pupils each, long lashes
- Six short face-tentacles around the mouth
- Tiny vestigial bat wings on the back
- Small pastel cloth bib tied around the neck

Composition: full-body or three-quarter shot, soft pastel blue-green background with faint nebula stars, gentle nursery lighting, photorealistic-meets-plush, vertical 9:16. Optional faint cosmic glow when he's emotional. No text, no humans, no other creatures.
prompts.sceneContinuity: Smol Cthulhu MUST match the reference exactly — same six face-tentacles, same three-pupil eyes, same bib, same tiny wings. Do not turn him into an adult Cthulhu. Maintain perfect character continuity.
prompts.evalCriteria:
PASS criteria — ALL must hold:
- A single small chubby eldritch baby is clearly visible
- Sea-green body, three-pupil indigo eyes, six face-tentacles, tiny wings, bib
- Mood and environment match the scene
- No text, no humans, no other creatures

FAIL on any of: adult-proportions Cthulhu, missing bib, missing tentacles, wrong eye count, multiple creatures.

archetypes.label: First Day Of Preschool
archetypes.guidance: Smol's first day at non-Euclidean preschool → makes a friend → cosmic art class (wholesome).

archetypes.label: Accidental End Of World
archetypes.guidance: Tries to bake cookies → temporarily summons the void → reality patched by nap time (comedy).

archetypes.label: Thunderstorm Feelings
archetypes.guidance: Is scared of his first big thunderstorm → caretaker comforts him → finds the storm beautiful (heartwarming).

archetypes.label: The Prophecy Tantrum
archetypes.guidance: Drops his ice cream → minor cosmic event → learns about disappointment (sad/hopeful).

archetypes.label: Lost On The Tide
archetypes.guidance: Floats away from home in a tide pool → odyssey back → reunited (epic).

archetypes.label: First Fhtagn
archetypes.guidance: Whispers his first word → caretaker bursts into joyful tears (dramatic-wholesome).

first-day-of-preschool: Day one at non-Euclidean preschool. He brought juice.
He made a friend in the third dimension and the fifth one too.
Snack time. Art time. Mild reality-warping time.
accidental-end-of-world: He just wanted cookies. The void had other ideas.
Reality blinked. Smol said sorry. Reality forgave him.
The oven preheated. So did the apocalypse. Briefly.
thunderstorm-feelings: Big rumble. Tiny tentacles. Big feelings.
He hid under the blanket. The blanket understood.
He found the storm beautiful, eventually.
the-prophecy-tantrum: He dropped the scoop. Reality flickered. He cried.
It's okay to be sad about ice cream.
lost-on-the-tide: The wave took him. Home was very far now.
He paddled with all six tentacles. He paddled brave.
Three nights. Two stars. One way home.
first-fhtagn: Today he said his first word. It rewrote the ocean a little.

closingCtas: Tag a friend who needs softness

musicStyleHint: soft music-box lullaby with whale-song undertones; subtle reversed reverb on emotional beats
